title: Antique Bronze Glass Shelf, 16-Inch Triple Tier Wall Mount Vanity Shelf With Solid Brass Hardware And Tempered Glass, Allied Brass
body_html:
Get more bathroom storage without cluttering your vanity—this triple tier wall-mount glass shelf keeps daily essentials organized and easy to reach — available in Antique Bronze, which combines deep brown tones with subtle warm highlights, offering heritage appeal with modern durability. Backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty.

  • Antique Bronze brings rich depth and character
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Maintains a crisp, modern look with concealed screw mounting hardware
  • Built for daily use with solid brass hardware and thick tempered glass
  • Choose a finish that coordinates with your modern bathroom hardware and contemporary bath accessories

Why it lasts: Solid brass hardware delivers lasting durability and strength.

Specs

  • Product type: Triple tier glass vanity shelf (wall mount)
  • Glass size: 16 x 5 inches
  • Glass thickness: 3/8 in (0.38 in)
  • Glass details: Tempered, beveled-edged
  • Material: Brass hardware
  • Mounting: Concealed screw mounting; wall-mounted
  • Weight capacity: 6 lb
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included: Glass shelf and all installation hardware
  • Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4"
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Complete your bathroom with coordinating pieces to match your minimalist bathroom fixtures style.
